title: Exclude funded single and disjoint double BIT endpoint exchanges
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

All 11,441 price-positive single supplier exchanges among 294,118 nested candidates fail causal scheduling, invertibility, or a chart-block rank invariant under invertible endpoint bases. A separate four-label model holds terminal equations fixed. Of 576,300 legal nonself exchanges, exactly 816 funded disjoint pairs pass the joint rank filter, and every combined dependency graph has a directed cycle.

## Task and overlap

Refined #7852 follow-up on main `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`, toolkit `41beda1d6435760dc99e38bd7e65f36798aad212`, and native comparator #7830 at `87fbf4f7b35b0f18ab12b5767775a9a424cf0b15`. Distinct from the original intermediate split screen #7991 `6b18f13fcb612eadb2eb0df450a4da344013585f`. The original 411 bridge is protected in both rosters.

## Validation

Cold `sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS` and `python3 -I -B verify.py` passed all 21 hashes, two literal changed-word controls in both orientations, exact rational nesting, both trial rates and the cyclic control.

## Open next questions

Allow a changed third paid equation or terminal stock beyond the original rows and bind a full word and invoice if a candidate remains.
